title: CandidateRecord
description: V3.8.1 -- the lightweight, discovery-only-mode candidate record. Contains ONLY factual discovery information (never FIT/GAP scores, maps_position/organic_position, an SEO wedge, competitor analysis, buying-signal analysis, contact identity, an email, a dossier, an asset, an email draft, or a send window -- none of those are required or produced by discovery-only mode). Built by scripts/candidate_verification.py: build_candidate_record() from the existing prospect record (schemas/prospect.schema.json) once it reaches CANDIDATE_VERIFIED, and synced to the Google Sheets CANDIDATES tab (scripts/handoff_lib.py: CANDIDATE_COLUMNS) so ChatGPT + the user can take over from here.

lead_id.description: Primary identity -- matches the prospect record's `id`. Sync is idempotent on this field: rediscovering the same business never creates a duplicate CANDIDATES row.

domain.description: Derived deterministically from `website` (scripts/rescore_leads.py: domain_of) -- never a separate research fact.

phone.description: From the raw discovery candidate -- discover_prospects.py's discovery_candidate.schema.json already captures this, but the shared prospect record does not carry it forward (V2-era shape, unchanged); this is the one field this module reads from the raw candidate rather than the persisted prospect record.

profile_url.description: Google Business Profile URL, if the discovery pass found one -- mirrors the prospect record's google_business_profile_url

discovery_source.description: e.g. 'v3.5_fresh_discovery / roofing / Indianapolis, IN' -- which market-cell discovery call produced this candidate

verification_status.description: The deterministic basic-verification outcome (scripts/candidate_verification.py: verify_candidate_basic) -- never a FIT/GAP/qualification judgment.

basic_business_facts.description: The small, honest bag of extra facts discovery already returned cheaply. Every field is optional/nullable -- missing stays null, never guessed.
